name: fix113_sleep_loot
verifies: fix-113 (owner: a slept orc could still be talked to; let me loot him): an orc held by the Sleep spell is not talkable; Use opens his loot page (like a knocked-out NPC: rolled plunder + carried stacks + weaponry), the items move to the hero, and without the G3 master-thief path the robbery is a theft (robtheft). He wakes after 30 s without a grudge (he slept, saw nothing). G3 path: sneaking with Perk_MasterThief robs a second slept orc without a theft
steps: spawn Orc_Warrior_01 attitude=neutral dist=3 side=front as=o1
spawn Orc_Warrior_01 attitude=neutral dist=3 side=front as=o2
notes: Player.log lines 'usenpc <orc>: helpless=True spellbound=True use=RobAsTheft -> dialog=False page=G3LootScreen theft=True' and 'takeall: +N items' (N > 0). The orc stays lying while the page is open; when he wakes (30 s) he says WhatWasThat and fetches a weapon if his was taken. Witnesses follow the item-theft rules (G3 IsBotheredByPlayerTheftOf): outside every AI zone nobody minds; in a camp each stack is counted against the zone and guards react. Docs/screens/fix113_sleep_loot.png: the loot page over the lying orc.
